$comment: THE BODY PALETTE — the fourth palette (founder 2026-10-12; MA memory project_brand_identity §body-palette).
SEMANTICS ONLY — no hex values live here, as in gems.json. The source hues are in qr/bqr.ts (BQR_OWNER_HUES),
the one place code reads them, and scripts/bqr.test.mjs §body-palette B3 fails if this file and that one disagree.
⚠️ A color here means a BODY — which of the five owns a code or a seal. Not a medium (gems.json), not a rate
(auras.json), and not a domain (tlds.json) — EXCEPT for H3, the one body organized by domains, whose body color
IS its domain's: an H3 code names its domain, never 'H3'.
THE CARRIER: CODES AND SEALS ONLY. Never a site accent (that stays gem-derived), never a theme. Pink stays reserved.
KHQR and every bank's code stay plain.
BELONGING, NEVER AUTHENTICITY. Anyone can print any color; the scan authenticates. Three pairs print alike and
that was accepted (heartbank.us ~ F333, heartbank.me ~ SW, heartbank.org ~ SW): H3's six hues span the wheel.
Every code prints at the B-QR recipe's darkness (bqrInkFor), so only the hue differs and all bodies scan alike.
